title: Spec 015 deterministic contract validation and fail-closed readiness gates

phases.objective: Prove deterministic, credential-free Spec 015 contract validation and read-only readiness evaluation while keeping provider, database, migration, and Production mutations fail closed.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The validator facade accepts only internally consistent identity, dependency, binding, publication, lifecycle, ownership, export, AI safety, CAS, and readiness-preview contracts, and returns blocked/no-write outcomes for unresolved authority or stale state.
steps: Load the pure Spec 015 validators and the read-only readiness facade with deterministic fixtures.
Evaluate valid and invalid tenant, Brand, dependency, binding, lifecycle, ownership, export, AI safety, and compare-and-set inputs.
Compute the deterministic readiness/impact manifest and verify that no validator consumes secrets or performs persistence/provider writes.
Run the runtime gate and repository policy plan regressions with finalizer identity supplied only as non-secret configuration.
Run the tenant, workspace authority, and sidecar certification contract checks while preserving fail-closed semantics.
assertions: Valid contract fixtures pass with stable deterministic output.
Wrong-scope, cross-tenant, stale-hash, ambiguity, revoked-delegation, and invalid-transition fixtures fail closed.
Credential-free bindings and no-secret outputs never expose private keys, tokens, passwords, or authorization headers.
Readiness and impact preview are read-only and do not persist, migrate, dispatch, or mutate a provider.
Runtime-open identity, migration/readback, and provider fail-closed gates remain blocked until authoritative evidence is present.
The policy live-plan runner records finalizer App identity resolution without executing an apply mutation.
Tenant Platform Plugin and Workspace Resource Authority checks preserve canonical authority and cross-scope rejection.

phases.objective: Bind the contract package to authoritative persistence and governed migration/readback only after a separately reviewed Production authority exists.
Prove upgrade, revocation, retry, and unknown-provider-outcome behavior across repeated readiness cycles without widening authority.
This contract package has no provider canary authority.
This contract grants no Production, deployment, migration Apply, database, Cloudflare, provider, credential, or external-send authority.
